regions.text: に原因が存してるる。また尿を蒸發し強熟して燐が待られたことは、生理前燃境の終局産物として尿の中に含有せられてゐた燐酸鹽と、それに加へられた化學約作用とが原因であつたのである。

quote.translation: That phosphorus was obtained by evaporating urine and heating it strongly was caused, in the same way, by the phosphate contained in the urine as an end product of physiological combustion, together with the chemical action applied to it.

regions.text: 昭電事件の調べがたまたま買動事件に開係を有つやうになつたのは、取調べを受けた人物の個人前性格と社會的境過とにその根本原因があつたのでなければなら吸。

quote.translation: And that the investigation of the Shōden case happened to become connected with the decorations-buying affair must have had its root cause in the personal character and the social circumstances of the person under examination.

regions.text: 斯やうにして目的々偶然は定言的偶然と同じ方向を取つて因果必然へ、少なくこも狭義の因果性の間題へ遭元せられるのである。

quote.translation: In this way teleological contingency, taking the same direction as categorical contingency, is reduced to causal necessity, or at least to the problem of causality in the narrow sense.

regions.text: 因果性の地平において因果的偶然の問題が残つてるる。因果必燃の非存在を消極前に目撃する因果的滑極的偶然について先づ述べよう。

quote.translation: On the horizon of causality, the problem of causal contingency remains, and I shall first discuss negative causal contingency, in which the non-existence of causal necessity is negatively witnessed.

regions.text: 原子論を採用したェビクロスは原子の本来の運動を上から下に向ふ垂直運動と考へたが、何等の原因なくして（fwaTies）おのづから（sponte）垂直線より極めて少しく逸れ

quote.translation: Epicurus, who adopted atomism, thought that the original motion of the atoms was a vertical motion from above downwards, but he taught that there are atoms which, without any cause (ἀναιτίως) and of themselves (sponte), deviate very slightly from the vertical line .
